title: LightCarbon LCR017-D Super Light frameset recheck
notes: Exact LCR017-D page names it the Super Light Disc Brake Road Carbon Frameset, claims a super-light 870 g size-52 frame with sizes from 850 to 945 g (±30 g), and a 700x32C maximum. Its only aero wording says integrated routing keeps the bike clean and aerodynamic; climbing is not mentioned.
